correctness.rationale: The all-pairs condition is equivalent to local distance-two midpoint escape by a shortest-path rerouting argument. In Fibonacci cubes, singleton exclusion is precisely simultaneous flippability of adjacent zeros; this yields the exact run restrictions. Pairs of feasible vertices are forbidden precisely when they are opposite corners of a four-cycle. Counting the allowed words by end/interior gap lengths gives the rational generating series; the conflict graph has degree <= binom(n,2), so greedy independence proves the quadratic-factor sandwich. The unique dominant positive pole gives the Narayana-cows exponential root. Direct geodesic enumeration for dimensions 2..6 and component polynomial calculations through 14 agree.

value.rationale: The exact exponential growth rate is a natural all-dimensional invariant of Fibonacci-cube visibility, improving qualitatively on the ambient Fibonacci growth scale. It is motivated by a previously open total-visibility problem and uses a full eligible-vertex structural classification, rather than an arbitrary small-case computation. The polynomial-factor bound can guide asymptotics and algorithms even without exact finite maxima.
